TreeMMM Quickstart

Source: vignettes/quickstart.Rmd
quickstart.Rmd

A five-minute tour of TreeMMM

TreeMMM is a tree-based Marketing Mix Modeling tool. Given a panel of customer-by-period observations and a set of promotional columns, it fits a gradient-boosted tree model, computes SHAP-derived attribution shares per promotional channel, and produces marginal-ROI response curves.

This vignette walks through the smallest end-to-end run.

Generate a synthetic panel

The package ships with six synthetic data-generating processes (DGPs) with known ground truth. We use the pharma DGP at a small scale:

library(treemmm)

ds <- generate_pharma_dataset(
  n_customers  = 50,
  n_periods    = 12,
  random_state = 42
)

# The result is a list with three elements:
names(ds)
#> [1] "df"           "ground_truth" "columns"

ds$df is the panel; ds$columns is the role mapping; ds$ground_truth contains the planted attribution shares (the answer the model is trying to recover):

head(ds$df)
#>    customer_id period outcome rep_visits dtc_advertising samples peer_programs

Configure the pipeline

run_config() packages the pipeline parameters; column_spec() describes which column plays which role. The defaults pick a sensible objective based on the outcome distribution.

cfg <- run_config(
  columns = column_spec(
    customer_id  = ds$columns$customer_id,
    time_col     = ds$columns$time_col,
    outcome_col  = ds$columns$outcome_col,
    promo_vars   = ds$columns$promo_vars,
    control_vars = ds$columns$control_vars
  ),
  objective       = "auto",
  n_optuna_trials = 2L,
  n_folds         = 3L,
  min_train_frac  = 0.5,
  random_state    = 42L
)

Run 

result <- treemmm_run(ds$df, cfg)

Inspect the result

The recovered attribution shares per channel:

sort(unlist(result$attribution_shares), decreasing = TRUE)
#>          rep_visits             samples     dtc_advertising       peer_programs 
#>          0.46739666          0.27261720          0.15388800          0.04942473 
#> digital_impressions        market_index         seasonality          conference 
#>          0.03116750          0.01418174          0.01132417          0.00000000

Per-fold performance metrics:

do.call(rbind, lapply(result$fold_metrics, as.data.frame))
#>   fold        r2     wmape      mae n_test
#> 1    1 0.4020115 0.6539378 1529.462    100
#> 2    2 0.5290944 0.5688630 1499.841    100
#> 3    3 0.5575484 0.5481093 1327.005    100

  • See vignette("dgp_play") for how to tune DGP parameters and inspect the planted ground truth.
